prediction_question: For a dispatched Austin police 911 call, will a patrol unit reach the caller more than a fixed minutes threshold after the call is dispatched?
prediction_time: At dispatch: the moment the call is assigned a priority and a patrol sector. Only fields known then may be features. Arrival, closing, final-classification and injury fields are excluded.
target_definition: Binary: portal column response_time (integer seconds) exceeds threshold T. T is chosen once from the measured training-window distribution and frozen in the construction script before any scoring. T is NOT yet chosen; measuring the distribution is the first construction step.
